lines.en: I close in on foot, no flying.

lines.zh: 地面战斗才是我的路数。
lines.en: Ground fighting is my style.
One push off the ground and I'm gone.
I circle to find an angle.
Short steps, but fast.
I know this tournament stage well.
I move forward low.
My shoes scrape the ground.
Watch where my feet land.
I can chase you without flying.
Get close enough to strike.

lines.zh: 你站得太直，左肋是空的。
lines.en: You stand too straight. Your left ribs are open.
My ki settles in my belly.
My fist loosens, then tightens.
I'm replaying that last move.
Standing like this is training too.
The wind snaps my clothes.
I'm in no hurry; you move first.
Lower the hips a little.
That last one wasn't clean.
Three in, two out - you're rattled.
Roll the wrists, loosen up.
Nice air in this place.
I settle my weight low and firm.
I've got the measure of your ki.
Is that all you've got?
Don't let your eyes wander; watch my hands.
Your stance has a gap. Know that?
I don't need full power to win.
Come on, show me your punch.
You grip so hard the blood leaves your knuckles.
Who's that behind you?
I never underestimate an opponent.
One step closer and I strike.
I haven't used my full strength yet.
I'm smiling because I'm enjoying this.
This match is mine to fight.
Your form looks trained.
I'm getting serious.

lines.zh: 准备好了吗？我可不留手。
lines.en: Ready? I won't hold back.

lines.zh: 从你的肩膀看得出下一招。
lines.en: Your shoulders give away your next move.
That one had weight.
I give half a step and steady.
Your punch has improved.
I grin through my teeth.
My breathing skipped a beat.
That woke me up.

lines.zh: 我不闪这一下，是为了看清。
lines.en: I took that one to see it clearly.
Again; I'm not afraid.
I gather my ki again.
Can we eat after the fight?
That smell is distracting me.
I really am hungry.
After this match is over.

lines.zh: 你带在身上就拿出来吧。
lines.en: If you're carrying it, bring it out.
Smells like buns to me.
A full belly means real strength.
Set it aside before it gets stepped on.
After training I always want food.
Is there more of it?
Shoulder to shoulder; don't hold back.
That shove had weight to it.
Close range suits me better.
Hold your ground; don't get pushed off.
We're a bit too close.
You stepped on me.
Whoever charges first moves first.
That impact is nothing.
I use your force to turn.

lines.zh: 武道会不是谈这个的地方。
lines.en: The tournament isn't the place for this.
Finish the fight, then we'll talk.
My head is full of techniques.
This outfit isn't suited to it.

lines.zh: 我还没到想这些的时候。
lines.en: I'm not at that point yet.
You're certainly direct.
Wait until I'm a bit stronger.
I'm more interested in fists and feet.
Don't hold up my training.
We'll discuss that later.
Whose is this on the ground?
I bend down and pick it up.
Could this work as a wrist wrap?
If it isn't mine, leave it.
Heavy; a good piece of iron.
Could this buy a meal?
I tuck it into my gi.
This was left by the stage edge.
Here, take it back.
Your ki shifted; I've marked you.
Your ki is scattered. I move first.
This is the opponent I wanted.
You're not dodging. Good.
Once my feet are set, I charge.
You're my opponent in this one.
Ki is gathered in my fist.
I can tell how strong you are.
I won't wait for you to be ready.
One target: you.
Don't turn your back; that's no fun.
Exactly the opponent I wanted.
I like where you're standing.
I'll settle this in three moves.
I'm on the same line as you.

lines.zh: 你右脚一沉，我就知道了。
lines.en: Your weight shifts right - I felt it.
I won't relax even without striking.
Another step back and you're out of bounds.
I'm waiting for your first punch.
Your ki is starting to float.
Your waist is too stiff.
I've seen this move before.
I don't move, and neither will you.
I keep the gap at one step.
Your ki scatters, so your punches slow.
I'll slip around to another side.
Turn the body; don't let him catch your wrist.
The instant you raise your hand, I move.
We're both waiting.
I don't like dragging it out.
Take this fist!
Left hook, then a low right.
Here's the elbow; don't block it head-on.
The knee follows up.
Fast enough for you?
Two more in the combo.
Keep your feet; stand firm.
Where the fist goes, I go.
I came up with this one myself.
You blocked it. Not bad.
The next one is heavier.
Don't back too far; I'll catch you.
The wind of my fist grazed your face.
After this combo I'll take a breath.
I haven't used ki blasts yet.
What ring is this?
Where's my opponent?
First, tighten my laces.
Good ki here; I can fight.

lines.zh: 出场要挑时间，就是现在。
lines.en: Timing an entrance matters. Now.
Are the people here strong?
Let me loosen my shoulders.
I smell food.
Look around before moving.

lines.zh: 第23届武道会的规矩我懂。
lines.en: I know the 23rd tournament's rules.
I don't plan to lose.
I'm set. Let's begin.
Who's first?
This outfit fits just right.
I'm ready.
Come on, warm-up.
Lift the ki.
This trip won't be wasted.
Fire caught my arm; the skin is hot.
I landed from a height and my knees buckled.
Underwater I can't hold it; my lungs are bursting.
The blast knocked me clean over.
Something struck my ribs.
That wicked force crept into my sinews.
Hunger makes my fist tremble.
Lightning struck; I'm numb all over.
The ground vanished; I'm falling.
